|strategy=By [mailto:poindexter_at_work@hotmail.com Paul Evans]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/dark/small/mindtricksdontworkonme.html</ref>

The one-turn beatdown has become a devastating maneuver used to decimate the Dark Side for years. Not any more with this card. With this card on the table, it sets up a safety blanket for the Dark Side, allowing them to leave a location a little thinner than they would like to, just the same as with a [[Ghhhk]]. Best of all, it is an Effect and cannot be denied use by the [[Frozen Assets]]/[[Draw Their Fire]] or [[Beggar]]/[[Draw Their Fire]] combos widely used in today's metagame.

Even better, this card can be used offensively by dropping an Enhanced character to take care of [[Han Solo{{!}}Han]] or taking on the entire scout beatdown crew on [[Endor (Dark){{!}}Endor]] to remove Midge from play. Either way it is used, the tricks the Light Side has won't work on this card.
|rulings=* Cards that cannot be forfeited (such as a character not participating in battle, or a [[Floating Refinery]]) do not prevent a player from canceling all remaining battle damage.<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Mind%20Tricks%20Don%27t%20Work%20On%20Me</ref>
